title: reader AuthConfig duplicates stoa_auth::AuthConfig fields
description: crates/reader/src/config.rs defines its own AuthConfig with required, users, credential_file, client_certs, trusted_issuers, oidc_providers (plus NNTP-specific drain_username). crates/auth/src/config.rs also defines AuthConfig with the same fields except drain_username. The is_dev_mode implementations are in sync now but must be maintained in parallel. If a new auth mechanism (e.g. WebAuthn, mTLS issuer) is added to stoa_auth::AuthConfig, the reader's AuthConfig and is_dev_mode must be manually updated. There is no compile-time link between them. A contributor who adds a field to stoa_auth::AuthConfig will not be reminded to update crates/reader/src/config.rs. The drain_username field is the only structural reason reader cannot use stoa_auth::AuthConfig directly. Consider moving drain_username into a reader-specific wrapper or extension struct so the shared AuthConfig can be used and field parity is enforced by the type system.
